samples.question: Dark is 1 and light is 0. Every square shows its ACTUAL value. XOR is 1 when inputs differ; AND is 1 only when both are 1; OR is 1 when either is 1. Each gate has a fixed hidden mode: NORMAL gives the named rule and INVERTED gives its opposite. Infer all modes from ACTUAL. In TEST, force only the red arrow to carry the shown bit. Do not force its source node or its other outgoing arrow. Recompute affected descendants with the inferred modes. What are P then Q? Answer 00, 01, 10, or 11.
